_metadata.description: Core operator workflows across UI and CLI.

requirements.title: UI and CLI expose equivalent core operations
requirements.description: The scenario shall expose snapshot, resolver status, device inventory, filtering preview/apply, optimization run, approval, rollback, and report export workflows through both UI and CLI without duplicating business logic outside the API.

validation.notes: Add API/CLI/UI tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-009] that verify both surfaces call the same operation contracts and represent errors consistently.
